title: Run → Product
outcome: What happens in use flows back. What happened is compared with what was intended, drift is found, and the intents, model and memory stay true.
why: Without this, what is built and what was intended pull apart without anyone noticing.
proof: Drift between the model and the work gets named.
Each learning is promoted on purpose.
must_not: Change an intent, or promote memory, without a person.

touches.title: Connect to what happens in use and in the market
Choose the tools and forums a project reads, and connect to them
Take in how the product is used, from its web analytics and product analytics
Take in what people say about the product and its market, from feedback tools and forums
Update the connections as the product and its tools change
